lines: // Work in little-endian decimal columns, so no monetary amount enters a machine word.
.decl operand_digit(line: symbol, operand: symbol, position: number, value: number)
operand_digit(l, field, p, n) :- recorded_line(l), quote_digit(s), quote_digit__line(s, l),
quote_digit__operand(s, field), quote_digit__position(s, p), quote_digit__value(s, n),
.decl conflicted_digit(line: symbol)
conflicted_digit(l) :- operand_digit(l, field, p, n), operand_digit(l, field, p, other), n != other.
.decl priced_line(line: symbol)
priced_line(l) :- operand_digit(l, "quantity", 0, _), operand_digit(l, "billed_periods", 0, _),
operand_digit(l, "period_price_micros", 0, _), operand_digit(l, "setup_price_micros", 0, _), !conflicted_digit(l).
// One machine pays for its billed periods and setup. The offset distinguishes
// equal products that contribute to the same column.
.decl machine_term(line: symbol, position: number, part: symbol, offset: number, value: number)
machine_term(l, p, "period", i, n) :- operand_digit(l, "billed_periods", i, a),
operand_digit(l, "period_price_micros", j, b), a > 0, b > 0, p = i + j, n = a * b.
machine_term(l, p, "setup", 0, n) :- operand_digit(l, "setup_price_micros", p, n), n > 0.
.decl machine_position(line: symbol, position: number)
machine_position(l, p) :- machine_term(l, p, _, _, _).
.decl machine_column(line: symbol, position: number, coefficient: number)
machine_column(l, p, n) :- machine_position(l, p), n = sum term : { machine_term(l, p, _, _, term) }.
// Multiply the machine charge by the quantity on each recorded line.
.decl line_term(line: symbol, position: number, offset: number, value: number)
line_term(l, p, i, n) :- machine_column(l, i, a), operand_digit(l, "quantity", j, b),
b > 0, p = i + j, n = a * b.
.decl line_position(line: symbol, position: number)
line_position(l, 0) :- priced_line(l).
line_position(l, p) :- line_term(l, p, _, _).
.decl line_column(line: symbol, position: number, coefficient: number)
line_column(l, p, n) :- priced_line(l), line_position(l, p), n = sum term : { line_term(l, p, _, term) }.
.decl total_term(quote: symbol, line: symbol, position: number, value: number)
total_term(q, l, p, n) :- recorded_quote(q), recorded_line__quote(l, q), line_column(l, p, n).
.decl incomplete_quote(quote: symbol)
incomplete_quote(q) :- recorded_quote(q), recorded_line(l), recorded_line__quote(l, q), !priced_line(l).
.decl total_position(quote: symbol, position: number)
total_position(q, 0) :- recorded_quote(q).
total_position(q, p) :- total_term(q, _, p, _).
.decl amount_column(amount: symbol, position: number, coefficient: number)
amount_column(l, p, n) :- line_column(l, p, n).
amount_column(q, p, n) :- total_position(q, p), !incomplete_quote(q), n = sum term : { total_term(q, _, p, term) }.
// The adapter supplies candidate carries, including terminal zeros. The pack
// calculates every output digit and requires the chain to cover all columns.
.decl carry(amount: symbol, position: number, value: number)
carry(a, p, n) :- quote_carry(s), quote_carry__amount(s, a), quote_carry__position(s, p), quote_carry__value(s, n),
.decl conflicted_carry(amount: symbol)
conflicted_carry(a) :- carry(a, p, n), carry(a, p, other), n != other.
.decl column_position(amount: symbol, position: number)
column_position(a, p) :- amount_column(a, p, _).
.decl next_position(amount: symbol, position: number, next: number)
next_position(a, p, next) :- carry(a, p, _), next = p + 1.
.decl normalized_column(amount: symbol, position: number, next: number, digit: number)
normalized_column(a, p, next, d) :- amount_column(a, p, n), carry(a, p, c),
next_position(a, p, next), carry(a, next, b), available = n + c, shifted = b * 10,
d = available - shifted, d >= 0, d <= 9.
normalized_column(a, p, next, d) :- carry(a, p, c), next_position(a, p, next), carry(a, next, b),
!column_position(a, p), shifted = b * 10, d = c - shifted, d >= 0, d <= 9.
.decl normalized_prefix(amount: symbol, position: number)
normalized_prefix(a, 0) :- carry(a, 0, 0).
normalized_prefix(a, next) :- normalized_prefix(a, p), normalized_column(a, p, next, _).
.decl complete_amount(amount: symbol)
complete_amount(a) :- normalized_prefix(a, p), carry(a, p, 0), !conflicted_carry(a),
last = max column : { column_position(a, column) }, p > last.
.decl amount_digit(amount: symbol, position: number, digit: number)
amount_digit(a, p, d) :- complete_amount(a), normalized_prefix(a, p), normalized_column(a, p, _, d).
.output amount_digit
